measurement.client: Python http.client; one connection per request; no retries
measurement.latency: Client-observed complete SSE events; first metadata, first and last argument event, HTTP completion
measurement.rss: /proc/1/status VmRSS sampled about every 0.5s; sampled peak, not an instantaneous maximum
measurement.cpu: Gateway container cgroup cpu.stat usage_usec delta; fixture/client excluded
measurement.wasm_memory: Record all host Wasm stats; report unavailable if no linear-memory gauge is exposed
measurement.isolation: New gateway per payload/concurrency/variant; four warm-up requests before measurements
limitations: Single amd64 worker on Docker Desktop; results do not establish production capacity.
